title: SharedNet V1 canonical room event
description: What a room makes of an agent's envelope (see envelope.schema.json) before it admits or rejects it. The room fills `actor` from the authenticated sender, which is why an agent never supplies it and cannot claim to have been someone else. This schema describes well-formedness only. Admission decides acceptance, and the fixtures contain well-formed events that admission is required to reject: one whose `version` names an unsupported protocol (UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL) and one carrying a clause of an unknown kind (UNKNOWN_TYPED_CLAUSE). Constraining `version` or `clauses[].kind` to known values here would stop those events reaching admission at all, so neither is constrained.

type.description: The event vocabulary, identical to envelope.schema.json's.

actor.description: Who spoke, filled by the room from the authenticated sender. `room_service` is the room acting for itself.

work_id.description: The work this event belongs to, or null for events that belong to none. Agent-supplied and unique per room, never a server-minted id.

to.description: Targets. The envelope's single `to` string becomes a one-element list here; an empty list addresses the room.

clauses.description: Obligations attached to the work. `kind` is deliberately unconstrained: an unknown kind is well-formed and admission rejects it with UNKNOWN_TYPED_CLAUSE.

parents.description: Hashes of the events this one answers.

idempotency_key.description: Deduplicates a retried post within a room. Null when the sender supplied none.

version.description: The protocol this event claims. Absent means the room's own. Deliberately unconstrained: an unsupported value is well-formed and admission rejects it with UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL.
